M1.name: Spirit:
M1.text: The festival is very pretty and lively.

M2.name: Spirit:
M2.text: This harvest has brought a lot of crops for us. The kingdom will be well fed.

M3.name: Spirit:
M3.text: Look at the various vendors! The king is so generous to bring so many for us.

S2.name: Spirit:
S2.text: Why does the king still host this?

S3.name: Spirit:
S3.text: The king must be hoarding all the good crops for himself!

S3.name: Spirit:
S3.text: What about us? We are YOUR people!
